specs_note: height_cm, weight_kg and payload_kg were already on file from the pre-catalogue internal record and independently match the product-owner-supplied Humanoid Guide material. degrees_of_freedom, hand_dof and runtime_minutes added from that material. walk_speed_ms records the source's stated 4 km/h WALKING speed, converted (4 / 3.6 = 1.11 m/s); the source separately states a 5 km/h MAX speed, a distinct figure this schema has no second field for, recorded here rather than conflated or dropped. The source also describes 20-DoF hands with haptic feedback and a proprietary "Carbon AI" control system, for which no dedicated fields exist; recorded here for the same reason.
